_: Ultraman (Halloween's code base and wiring) on the SPOOKY rig (PAD-952): marty02's 'Halloween MM Edition' 3.1 (VPUniverse file 16526),
JPSalas' template dressed as Halloween, not the machine's layout. Written by gen_halloween_maps.py,
which says how each object was matched.
platform: spooky puts PAD.Controller on tools/spooky_emu's board (spkbridge.py): switches, coils
and LEDs are the game's own numbers; the subway lifters are servos 0 and 1 (coils 32, 33).
title: um

cabinet._: the Pinotaur cabinet (spktitles.py aliases): 1000 + the switch number

trough._: TROUGH 1 (by the eject) to TROUGH 7, the jam opto last; 7 balls (installed_balls)

saucers._: kicker -> the switch it holds and how the coil kicks it out (dir, power); stack = the lane's switches behind; kick_from = where the ball leaves; enter = the opto it passes on the way in; feeders = other holes into the same lane

K1G.name: the left scoops (LEFT BOTTOM / MIDDLE / TOP SCOOP) into LEFT SUBWAY 1-4

K1D.name: LOWER RIGHT SCOOP into the RIGHT SUBWAY lifter

lock.name: GUESS: the top-left lock as the CROSSOVER, let out by the crossover dump

drop_resets._: the bank reset coil's sub: every target of the bank stands again

solenoids._: Spooky coil [0, n] (CoilConfig.cs; a servo s is [0, 32 + s]) -> the small number the table sees (core.vbs flippers 46/48); callback a sub of the table's or the bridge's (null = nothing fires). Names are the game's own.

lamps._: table light -> the game's LED [n // 64, n % 64] (lightconfig.json's num; rgb: one LED, lit in its colour). marty's lights are the template's own: only those where the game has the insert, GUESS.

Light12.name: bank_1
Light12.note: the light at Target1 (the pumpkin bank's left)

Light25.name: left_spinner
Light25.note: GUESS: the light by the left spinner

Light5.name: left_outlane
Light5.note: GUESS: the light above the left outlane

Light9.name: right_outlane
Light9.note: GUESS: the light above the right outlane

Light6a.name: hedge_progress_1
Light6a.note: GUESS: the light by the left bottom scoop

Light20a.name: hedge_progress_2
Light20a.note: GUESS: the light by the left middle scoop

Light8a.name: hedge_progress_3
Light8a.note: GUESS: the light by the left top scoop

switches._: object -> the Spooky game's switch number (spkbridge.py: the number itself); event hit (pulse), spin, slingshot, drop (stays until the bank resets; up_closed: made while it STANDS). Names are SwitchConfig.cs's labels. marty's table is not the machine's layout: GUESS where a game on the table should confirm.

sw5.name: LEFT ORBIT
sw5.note: GUESS: the top-left lane the table scores as its orbit

sw5a.name: RIGHT ORBIT
sw5a.note: GUESS: the right lane the table scores as its orbit

LeftRampDone.name: LEFT RAMP EXIT
LeftRampDone.note: GUESS: the ramp ending at the top (564, 85)

RightRampDone.name: MIDDLE RAMP
RightRampDone.note: GUESS: the ramp ending at the left (63, 250)

Target1.name: DROP BANK LEFT
Target1.note: the pumpkin bank: made while standing
